name: alibabacloud-ecs-linux-os-troubleshooting
description: Use when a user needs to diagnose the current Alibaba Cloud ECS Linux machine or an explicitly specified ECS Linux instance remotely via aliyun CLI or OpenAPI MCP, including boot/Starting issues, SSH/VNC/Workbench login failures, network or disk/FS issues, performance anomalies, suspected mining or hidden processes, crash/hang, clock drift, or configuration not taking effect.

findings.excerpt: Run `curl http://100.100.100.200/latest/user-data` to check whether content exists. If it does not, User-Data is not configured.
- Run `cat /root/.ssh/authorized_keys ~/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null` to check whether a public key has been implanted.
